_comment: Offline dictionary catalog read by the Dayfine app (Settings > Dictionary). Each entry is a GitHub Release asset in this repo; the app downloads it to %APPDATA%/dict-tool/dictionaries/<file>, verifies sha256 + row count, then renames it into place. Keep old tags alive: the app pins by url, never by 'latest'.
